messages.context: Arthur 介绍小人燃料的作用
messages.raw: §fFuel makes your Minion work harder for a limited time.
messages.text: Fuel makes your Minion work harder for a limited time.
messages.gloss: Minion 按项目既定译名译“小人”;这里的 Fuel 是小人燃料。
messages.zh: 燃料能让你的小人在一段时间内更卖力地工作。

messages.context: Arthur 举例说明小人燃料的种类
messages.raw: §fThere are multiple types of Fuel, like Coal, Enchanted Bread, and many more!
messages.text: There are multiple types of Fuel, like Coal, Enchanted Bread, and many more!
messages.gloss: Coal 和 Enchanted Bread 分别采用《我的世界》材料译名“煤炭”和“附魔面包”。
messages.zh: 燃料有很多种,比如煤炭、附魔面包等等!

messages.raw: §fMinions always have 4 Upgrade Slots where you can place Fuel or other items.
messages.text: Minions always have 4 Upgrade Slots where you can place Fuel or other items.
messages.zh: 小人始终有 4 个升级槽,可以放入燃料或其他物品。

messages.raw: §fIf you place your Minions poorly, they will complain!
messages.text: If you place your Minions poorly, they will complain!
messages.zh: 如果小人的摆放位置不合适,它们会抱怨的!

messages.raw: §fOpen their Menu and look for their Perfect Layout!
messages.text: Open their Menu and look for their Perfect Layout!
messages.zh: 打开它们的菜单,查看最佳布局!

messages.raw: §fMy favorite Minion Upgrade is the §aCompactor§f, soooo useful!
messages.text: My favorite Minion Upgrade is the Compactor, soooo useful!
messages.zh: 我最喜欢的小人升级是压缩器,实在太太太好用了!

segments.text: My favorite Minion Upgrade is the
segments.zh: 我最喜欢的小人升级是

messages.raw: §fI have one in my Minion, look!
messages.text: I have one in my Minion, look!
messages.zh: 我的小人里就装了一个,快看!

messages.raw: §fOnce you unlock a Minion, you also unlock all their Level up recipes!
messages.text: Once you unlock a Minion, you also unlock all their Level up recipes!
messages.zh: 解锁一种小人后,它的所有升级配方也会一并解锁!
